name: Pixar Place Hotel Great Maple Modern American Eatery: Buttermilk Pancakes, Eggs, Salmon & Famous Maple Bacon Donuts
brandOrRestaurant: Great Maple (Pixar Place Hotel · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: Right across from the Grand Californian/DCA entrance inside Pixar Place Hotel, Great Maple serves scratch-made American breakfasts (eggs, sourdough toast, buttermilk pancakes), roasted chicken/salmon dinners, and their made-to-order warm Maple Bacon Donuts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic American Breakfast with scrambled eggs and sourdough toast; if sharing the famous warm Maple Bacon Donuts in remission, pair half a donut with your eggs and take lactase.
watchOuts: Maple Bacon Donuts are fried to order and rich—share one with the table after eating protein
